title: Block incoming traffic on a specific port
summary: Configure UFW to deny incoming connections to a specific port. This prevents external access to services running on that port.

steps.explain: Deny incoming traffic on a specific port.

rollback.explain: Delete the rule by its number. First, find the number using 'sudo ufw status numbered'.

placeholders.name: RULE_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The index number of the rule to delete.

warnings: Blocking a port may disrupt services that rely on it.
